rows.content: The Baal Shem Tov tells him - No! That today is Shabbat Rosh Chodesh is a special event that the One Above Himself shows you this time so that you should learn from it in your service! This must give you a jolt! And every time that the One Above shows you that it is holy Shabbat you must derive a special lesson,
